sentences.text: Edith Marsh (S2) stated she uses a walking frame and does not go upstairs.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated her son Gary lives with her, works at the garage on Station Road, and helps her with shopping, getting up, and administering tablets.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated Gary works from 8:00 to 6:00, sometimes later.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she is alone all day while Gary is at work, relying on the television for company.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she can mostly get to the toilet herself but uses a commode and wear pads because she is not always quick enough.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated Gary changes her if the pad is wet when he is home, or she manages it herself.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she visits most afternoons and reported that Edith Marsh (S2) is often left in wet clothes, with the pad and skirt wet, on four or five days a week.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she helps Edith Marsh (S2) change if she will let her.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated Gary usually leaves her a sandwich for lunch.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated there is no food in the fridge, noting on Saturday it was empty except for a bit of gone-off milk, and that she brought Edith Marsh (S2) a dinner round the
Pauline Reid (S3) stated the fridge has been empty three or four times in the last few weeks.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated Edith Marsh (S2) has not had her tablets for a week and the box is full since last Tuesday.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated the compartments from Tuesday the 17th onwards on the tablet box are still full, containing blood pressure and water tablets.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she forgets her tablets and Gary has been busy.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she has been living at her home since 1962 and does not want to move.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she would accept carers coming in if Gary does not mind, to avoid relying on him all day.
Edith Marsh (S2) denied that Gary or anyone has ever hit or hurt her, stating Gary is a good boy but just tired.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she has never seen anything like abuse and that Gary is not unkind to her, just not there.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she is raising a safeguarding concern regarding Edith Marsh (S2) being left wet, without food, and without tablets.
Edith Marsh (S2) agreed to the safeguarding concern being raised if it helps Gary.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she gets her pension paid into her own account and has her card.
Edith Marsh (S2) stated she does not receive Attendance Allowance.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she asked Gary once about Attendance Allowance.
Pauline Reid (S3) stated she is willing to continue popping in.
Pauline Reid (S3) provided her phone number as 0146.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she will ring Dr Patel (GP) about the missed tablets and ask the chemist about a blister pack and a check.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she will arrange an emergency home care package with two calls a day (morning and lunchtime) for washing, changing, and a meal, starting by Friday the 27
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she will phone Gary tonight to book his carer's assessment for next week.
Janet Fielding (S1) stated she will return on Wednesday the 2nd of December with the Attendance Allowance form.
